title: Evolution of hospitalized patient characteristics through the first three COVID-19 waves in Paris area using machine learning analysis.
summary: XGBoost/SHAP analysis alongside regression on 1,076 hospitalized patients shows COVID-19 severity risk-factor patterns changed over three Paris epidemic waves.
